initial:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a single exceptionally refined, realistic desktop website screenshot for the NEXT section of 8x Social's minimal landing page. 1536x1152 landscape. This is a mid-scroll continuation of an existing stone page, not a hero or presentation board. No browser chrome, no mockup perspective, no explanatory annotations. Design quality: confident modern editorial web design, warm black typography, beautiful optical kerning, generous but deliberate whitespace. Concrete business content is the original 8x Social site's comparison of creator networks, influencer marketing and paid advertising. Render a real feasible interaction design, not an abstract illustration.

Entire canvas uniform flat warm stone #e9e5dc. Black #111 and sparing vermilion #f34b32 only. Absolutely no horizontal or vertical divider rules, no framed cards, no bars, no bordered table, no background slabs, no gradients, no charts, no floating dashboards, no maps. No logo sculpture, no abstract dot fan. No photographs in the main new section. No exaggerated ornament. Match the clean continuous-page intent rather than adding decorative objects.

At very top about 100px, show the END of the existing previous section as a naturally cropped fragment to establish one continuous page: left, small monochrome TikTok Instagram YouTube Shorts marks, spread over about 300px; right, only a small lower-corner fragment of grayscale creator-video halftone dissolving into the shared stone, not a new face or complete new photo. Content above is outside viewport. No line beneath this. This is not a header: do NOT add navigation.
Main section starts at y about 200px with a left-aligned confident black headline, 110px scale at this canvas size, tight clean sans-serif: "A different way\nto grow." Final period orange. On right aligned with headline bottom, supporting text in readable 23px: "Creator networks bring content,\ndistribution and daily management together." Keep the message short, grounded and legible.
Below at y approximately 520px, three open text tab labels across the page, each beginning one of three equally spaced columns: "8x creator network" / "Influencer marketing" / "Paid advertising". First label bold black and marked by a small orange circular dot to its left. The other two labels muted warm gray. NO pills, rectangles, underlines or horizontal tab rails. Adequate spacing and click areas implied by whitespace.
Underneath is ONE shared detail area for the selected 8x mode, spread horizontally into three generous columns. This is not three cards. Each column has a restrained expressive circular dot motif at its top, about 70px wide: the first uses a compact loose 4x4 black dot cluster with a single orange dot; the second uses a denser 6x6 ordered dot cluster with three orange dots; the third uses a compact orderly 4x4 circle cluster all black with orange center. Tiny 4px dots, flat geometric print aesthetic, no particles thrown across page, no connectors. These are small chapter punctuation, not the hero visual.
Under each motif, black large beautifully typeset text on two lines:
Column 1 "Creator-led\ncontent."
Column 2 "Organic\ndistribution."
Column 3 "Managed\nend to end."
Below these, smaller readable descriptions in dark gray, max 3 lines:
1 "Creators make and publish\nin their own voice."
2 "Content reaches people\nthrough the feed."
3 "Briefs, reviews, payments.\nHandled by 8x."
Bottom left a restrained text link "Build your network ↗". No footer, no section number, no tiny slogans, no fake metrics, no badges.
Typography is the main visual: large enough to feel bold, excellent balance and editorial rhythm. No decorative grid behind type. Make every label exact and readable. It should feel like one continuous page whose small local controls change the content, not a sequence of presentation slides. This screenshot is the 8x selected state. Do not include alternative states or animation arrows within the image. The tab content is proposed UI based on original website content, not a reproduction of a product dashboard. Leave enough breathing space that everything fits elegantly in the view.
refinement:
Edit the supplied website concept with two precise corrections. Keep the stone background, main headline, support copy, dot motifs, all three large benefit statements, their descriptions, spacing and typography.
1. The three mode tabs must look like ONE compact selector controlling the ENTIRE three-column content area, not column headings. Replace the current widely distributed row with a single compact row at left under the headline: orange dot then black bold "8x network", then muted "Influencers", then muted "Paid ads". All three labels must occupy ONLY the left 45 percent of page width together, with about 30px gaps. Do not align those labels with the three feature columns. The three feature columns below all describe the currently selected 8x mode. No underlines or boxes. Keep enough vertical gap between the compact tab selector and the features.
2. At the very top left, show ONLY THREE platform marks: TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts. Remove the redundant standard YouTube play rectangle. Keep the naturally cropped previous-section photo fragment upper right as-is.
This must remain one beautiful continuous webpage screenshot, not a presentation, no borders or separators. Do not change any other design or content.
